study: Independent retrospective statistical similarity case study
eligibility: Wyscout Forward; reliable minutes >= 1200; >= 100 attacking-half actions; >= 60% in outside lanes. Both flanks included.

methods.category: RMS standardized distance across six equal categories; shooting shares one category.
methods.attack: Euclidean distance on standardized NPG/90 and tagged key passes/90.
methods.euclidean: Euclidean distance across seven equally weighted z-scores.
methods.pca: Euclidean distance on four unwhitened PCs (85% cumulative threshold).

preprocessing: Means and population SDs fitted on all 151 complete references including Salah. Tied ranks share minimum rank; player ID breaks top-K boundary ties.
percentile: 100 × (strictly lower count + half the tied count) / nonmissing reference size.
limitations: Observed on-ball flank involvement; nominal position and off-ball runs unmeasured.
Single-season, pooled leagues, no team or opponent adjustment.
Salah rates use 2922 reconstructed minutes; alternative 2907 tested.
Sterling has missing NPG due to an unresolved team-score discrepancy.
Recruitment accuracy, tactical fit and transfer feasibility unevaluated.

attribution.paper: Pappalardo et al., A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions (2019)
attribution.changes: Domestic events aggregated, minutes reconstructed, wide forwards selected, metrics standardized and ranked.
